source.title: Harmony4D test/03_grappling2.zip, sequence 043_grappling2
source.author: Rawal Khirodkar, Jyun-Ting Song, Jinkun Cao, Zhengyi Luo, Kris Kitani (Carnegie Mellon University), Harmony4D, NeurIPS 2024

reviewer: Codex visual inspection, independently checked by a second agent; not an expert capture review
status: approximate candidates, not an accepted mat calibration
uncertainty: Approximately +/- 8-12 original-image pixels at thick, blurred tape centerline intersections. Two views were marked directly from the photographs. Corner identity was inspected across views and compared with swapped alternatives. A three-point plane cannot independently validate planarity; additional views and mat points are required before replacing the ankle-based floor.

features.red_corner_a: Red/red tape junction: upper-left end in cam01; upper-left red corner in cam11.
features.red_corner_b: Other end of the same short red edge: lower-left corner in both views.
features.green_corner_c: Visible lower endpoint of the green edge, adjoining the long near red edge.
